records.title: Madeira Remote
records.scea90e502: Casa do Pico by Madeira Remote is a community-driven coliving in central Funchal for digital nomads, with dedicated workspaces, rooftop views, a jacuzzi, and access to coworking, events, and local perks.
records.description_markdown:
Casa do Pico is a coliving home created by Madeira Remote, a branch of Madeira Friends, with the mission of connecting locals and internationals and making everyone feel at home on Madeira Island. We created this space for digital nomads looking for the right balance between productivity, rest, community, and island exploration.

Located in central Funchal, Casa do Pico is a spacious T5 house designed for both comfortable living and remote work. The house includes 2 kitchens, 2 living rooms, an office/reading area, a dining area, a backyard with outdoor seating and a jacuzzi, plus a rooftop with beautiful ocean and city views. Each guest also has access to a dedicated desk with a monitor to support a productive work routine.

What makes the experience special is the community around it. Guests get access to Madeira Friends Hub, our coworking space, a discount card with 60+ local partners, networking events, workshops, and two WhatsApp groups: one for the house community and another for the wider digital nomad community on the island. Casa do Pico is more than a place to stay — it is a place to connect, work well, and experience Madeira with like-minded people.

records.title: The Louise by Clockwise
records.scea90e502: The Louise by Clockwise is a premium coworking space on Avenue Louise in Brussels, offering private offices, dedicated desks, and flexible work areas. Designed with sustainability in mind (BREEAM Excellent), it features landscaped terraces, meeting rooms, an auditorium, and a vibrant community with curated events, all in one of the city’s most prestigious districts.
records.description_markdown:
What sparked the idea?
Clockwise started with a simple vision: to transform traditional offices into spaces that feel flexible, inspiring, and community-driven. The idea came from noticing how rigid work environments often stifle creativity and connection. We wanted to create places where people genuinely enjoy working and collaborating.

Who’s behind it?
Behind Clockwise is a passionate team dedicated to redefining the workplace experience. From our designers to our community managers, everyone shares the same goal, making work feel effortless and connected.

What makes this location special to you?
Initially, all Clockwise locations were in the UK, but as the concept grew, we expanded across Europe. The Louise location is our second in Brussels, and that makes it particularly exciting. It’s right in the heart of the city’s vibrant business district, yet it feels warm and personal. For me, it’s special because it represents growth and the chance to build a thriving community in a space that truly reflects Clockwise’s values.

records.title: Puzl CowOrKing - Old City Center
records.scea90e502:
puzl CowOrKing creates workspaces for IT companies who’d rather focus on building their business than managing an office. We take care of everything else - from the space itself to the details that make work actually work.

We operate three locations in Sofia and one in Budapest, transforming industrial and historic buildings into tech hubs where companies grow, collaborate, and learn from each other.
records.description_markdown: ## We help IT humans. We started as an IT startup. We needed an office. We didn't find one. Long story short, now we make coworking spaces for amazing IT humans. Cool, huh? We design 300 kg desks and get to see how teams build their businesses on them. Oh!, we also get to explore abandoned buildings, walk around barefoot and connect with remarkable people. Basically... we are having fun. ## Our mission. To help IT humans and teams grow in a productive environment. We created Puzl CowOrKing to help IT humans and teams make better products and services. How? By giving them a gorgeous place to work from and a supportive community of like-minded people to share the journey with. As a company, we measure our success by how well we achieve that mission. It is the achievements of our members and the impact that the environment has on their growth that defines the added value of our business model – not financial ratios.  This is also reflected in the way our Puzl CowOrKing spaces are made. They are not built like common offices. Instead, we design them as community environments which foster efficiency, collaboration, and creativity, both within companies and individuals.

records.title: Altspace Coworking
records.scea90e502: Coworking in Bansko that feels like home, 3 locations, with fast WiFi, built-in community, and your next adventure waiting in the mountains.
records.description_markdown:
Altspace started because Becky (the founder) was watching too many talented, interesting people sit alone in their apartments.

When she moved to Bansko in 2020, there was already this quiet wave of remote workers discovering the town. People came for the mountains, the low cost of living, the skiing…but during the day they were isolated. Working from kitchen tables, fighting with dodgy WiFi and talking to no one. Something about that felt really wrong.

Bansko had all the ingredients for an incredible remote work destination, but it didn’t yet have a space that felt intentionally built for both focus and belonging. So she built one!

Altspace opened in the middle of a global pandemic, which in hindsight sounds mildly unhinged…but the need was obvious. Within a year Altspace had expanded to a second location. By year three, a third. Not because there was some aggressive growth plan, but because the community kept outgrowing the rooms.

From day one, it was never about desks. It was about walking into a room and not having to explain yourself. It was about being surrounded by other people building things, working hard, figuring life out. It was about having deep focus during the day and someone to grab dinner with at night.

Over the years thousands of nomads have come through the doors. Some stay a week, some stay a season, quite a few changed their lives here! Friendships form, businesses launch, relationships start, collaborations happen over coffee that turn into actual companies.

There has also been something unexpected: people choosing to relocate to Bansko permanently because of the community they found inside the Altspace walls.

Altspace has quietly become one of the social anchors of the town. You can ski or hike in the morning, work properly during the day, and find real connection in the evening…not forced networking, just humans being humans.

At its core, Altspace exists to solve a simple problem: remote work doesn’t have to mean remote life.

And in a small mountain town in Bulgaria, that idea has grown into something much bigger than had ever been planned.

records.title: Coconut Office
records.scea90e502: Coworking with 3-sided glass fronts, lots of natural light & daily Scarlet Macaws flying by. Surf break, skate ramp, hammock deck & endless Costa Rican coffee!
records.description_markdown:
I first visited Costa Rica over 20 years ago. Our car broke down right at the bus stop in Calle Hermosa. I don't know if it was fate, but I rarely have car breakdowns, and perhaps I should have accepted destiny and simply stayed there.

Instead, I only returned many years later and started the Coconut Office.

Playa Hermosa has earned a reputation as one of the world's premier surfing destinations. In 2021, the American non-profit organization, Save the Waves Coalition, selected Playa Hermosa as the 11th World Surf Reserve globally.

The Coconut Office is designed specifically for clients seeking a productive work environment while enjoying surfing and tranquility. 

We love spending time with our guests while grilling, surfing, or going on other excursions. Many of the activities we enjoy with our guests are things we ourselves love doing: beach bonfires, cooling down in the river at Playa Hermosa, visiting a nearby waterfall, yoga, skateboarding...
records.s5716bab58:
Stayed here for a couple weeks. This place is world class. The apartments are the cleanest I have seen in Central America (and cleaner than any rental I’ve stayed at in the US as well), the internet is fast, the location is fantastic, and the owners are always there to help. This was our first time staying at coconut office, but it surely won’t be our last. I cannot recommend Coconut Office enough.Sebastian Vallone

Morten and Rosalia were the nicest hosts I’ve stayed during my 2 year digital nomad adventure. They make you feel like longtime friends and ensure you have an excellent stay. Morton even drove me to a beach an hour away to surf.
The complex is beautiful. Landscaping is pristine and the pool is both clean and deep. The apartment felt brand new and the kitchen is well stocked.

You can walk to a variety of restaurants and mini markets. They have free bikes you can use for further distances. Uber is also very cheap so a car is not a necessity.

I will definitely be back!Forrest Perry

I had a wonderful stay at the Coconut Office with Morten and Rosalia. Both of them were incredibly kind and welcoming, and they immediately made me feel at home.

During my time there, I had the chance to take an amazing surf lesson with Lucas, go on fantastic nearby trips to Manuel Antonio National Park—where I saw all kinds of wildlife—and visit some of the most beautiful waterfalls I’ve ever seen.
The absolute highlight of my stay was the day in Boca Barranca, which Morten made possible. There, I caught the best wave of my life – an unforgettable experience!
Thank you so much, Morten and Rosalia, for your hospitality and for making my time in Costa Rica truly special. Deniz Ertin

A fantastic place to perfectly combine work and leisure. Rosalia and Morten take great care of their guests. The apartments and workspaces are very comfortable and spacious. Thanks to the proximity to the beach, you can interrupt your workday at any time for a surf trip.

records.title: Stone Soup
records.scea90e502:
At Stone Soup, we believe successful work is built together. We bring professionals from different fields into a shared environment where they support, challenge, and grow alongside one another.
Coworking may be the same dish, but everyone prepares it differently. With years of experience and the right ingredients, we create a thoughtful and balanced environment. At Stone Soup you choose the ingredients that fit your needs and shape your own way of working within a community that grows together.
records.description_markdown: Stone Soup began in 2014, during the economic crisis in Greece, as a Social Cooperative with a clear mission: to support young professionals, unemployed individuals, and students by providing workspace, training, and job opportunities. We built Stone Soup ourselves. We painted the walls, repaired the infrastructure, and built or sourced the furniture, moving everything into place by hand. The space grew organically through use, shaped by the real needs of the people who worked in it. From the beginning, we focused not only on infrastructure, but on how a space makes people feel about their work and purpose. Over time, the space evolved into a full coworking hub with private offices, shared work areas, and meeting rooms that adapt to freelancers, startups, and growing teams. What remains unchanged is our commitment to community and collaboration. We intentionally operate at a human scale. While smaller than large corporate chains, we prioritize quality, reliable technology, and personal support. Our core offering covers essential professional needs, with the flexibility to tailor additional services when needed.

records.title: Impact Hub Athens
records.scea90e502:
Impact Hub Athens, part of a global network of 120+ Impact Hubs, is a social innovation hub that operates as a trusted intermediary, connecting institutions, communities, entrepreneurs, and scientists to create solutions with meaningful and long-term impact. 
We design and implement programs, develop strategic partnerships, and cultivate a comprehensive ecosystem that combines space, knowledge, and network. We provide tools, connections and support,enabling systemic change through collaboration.
records.description_markdown: Impact Hub Athens was founded in 2013, at a time when the concept of social entrepreneurship in Greece was not yet fully developed. There was no clear ecosystem, nor a shared language around impact—but there was a clear need. We started in a distinctive space in Psyrri with a simple idea: to create a meeting point for people who wanted to work differently more collaboratively, more openly, with a strong orientation toward society and the environment. At the beginning, we were primarily a community. People with ideas, teams looking for support, professionals who wanted to belong somewhere where entrepreneurship was not measured solely by financial indicators. Over the years, our role evolved. From a coworking space, we also became an organization designing and implementing programs. We supported early-stage teams as well as mature businesses and organizations seeking to redefine their footprint. We collaborated with public authorities, European institutions, and private partners on projects that went beyond theory and led to tangible outcomes. Today, Impact Hub Athens is simultaneously a space, a community, and a project implementation organization. It is people working together, programs running in different cities, and partnerships that extend beyond the boundaries of Athens and even beyond Greece.

records.scea90e502: A coworking space in Dublin with more: bright offices, meeting rooms, and a welcoming community to help you thrive.
records.description_markdown: What began in 2017 with a group of friends and 30 original members has grown into a vibrant community of hundreds. From the very start, Tara was never just about being a workspace – it was sea swims, workshops, rooftop beers, and the buzz of people connecting. Once a vacant site, the building itself has taken many forms over the years, from coworking floors and studios to offices and event spaces – always evolving with the people inside. From full-time members to day pass visitors, everyone who’s come through our doors has made Tara what it is today. With gigs, talks, pastry mornings and even the odd wedding, The Tara Building has become a community where connections and friendship last well beyond the walls of the building.

records.title: Culture Co-Working
records.scea90e502: Culture Co-Working offers flexible and modern coworking spaces in Cork designed for entrepreneurs, freelancers, remote workers, and growing companies. Our vibrant community, fully equipped workspaces, and professional meeting rooms provide the perfect environment to work, connect, and grow.
records.description_markdown:
### Our Story

Culture Co-Working was created with a simple idea: work should be flexible, inspiring, and connected. As the way people work began to change, we saw a growing need for professional spaces where entrepreneurs, freelancers, remote workers, and companies could work productively without the isolation of working from home.

What started as a vision to create a welcoming and professional workspace quickly grew into a thriving community. By offering modern coworking spaces, private offices, and fully equipped meeting rooms, Culture Co-Working became a place where people not only work—but also collaborate, share ideas, and support one another.

Located in the heart of Cork, our spaces were designed to combine productivity with community. Members benefit from flexible membership options, high-quality facilities, and a network of like-minded professionals who believe that great things happen when people work together.

Today, Culture Co-Working continues to grow as a hub for innovation, collaboration, and business development in Cork. Our mission remains the same: to provide inspiring workspaces where individuals and companies can focus, connect, and build their future.

records.title: Nesting Away
records.scea90e502: Nesting Away is an intimate coliving in the Italian countryside (1hr from Rome) where remote workers build real friendships while getting their best work done. Small intentional community (7 rooms), dual Starlink WiFi, dedicated coworking, shared dinners, and a swimming pool. Minimum stay: 2 weeks. Discovery call is required, no direct booking.
records.description_markdown: When Ukrainian-Italian couple Oleksandra and Federico first saw the property three years ago, it was half-abandoned, grey, with an overgrown garden. But they had a vision: a coworking space with panoramic views here, a swimming pool there. As digital nomads themselves, they knew what remote workers truly needed: not just WiFi and a desk, but a real home and community. After 12 months of renovation, Federico proposed to Oleksandra on the balcony they'd built together. Fun fact: the family who built the house shares Federico's exact surname, and it sits just 500 meters from the very first property they viewed on their hunt. It felt like destiny. Today, Nesting Away is central Italy's only coliving designed by digital nomads for digital nomads. Located next to the medieval town of Orte with direct trains to Rome, it's home to remote workers staying 2 weeks to several months - living the vision Ola and Fede saw in that abandoned house years ago.

records.title: Dolce Vita Coliving
records.scea90e502: Dolce Vita Coliving is a diffused coliving space in Vallo di Nera, Umbria, Italy, designed for remote workers and digital nomads seeking focus and connection. Set in a peaceful medieval village, it offers private rooms, coworking spaces, and shared areas within restored homes, all within a 3-minute walk.
records.description_markdown: 🌿 About Us Dolce Vita Coliving is a diffused coliving in central Italy for remote workers, digital nomads, and people ready to slow down and reset. It’s a place where focused work blends with authentic human connection and the rhythm of Italian village life. We are located in Vallo di Nera, one of the most captivating medieval villages in Umbria, less than two hours from Rome and Florence. With just 355 inhabitants, the village offers a peaceful, welcoming atmosphere overlooking the Valnerina valley, surrounded by rivers, forests, and mountains. Vallo di Nera is proudly recognized as: - One of Italy’s Most Beautiful Villages (Borghi più Belli d’Italia) - Orange Flag recipient for sustainable tourism - Bee-Friendly Municipality - Truffle City Our mission is simple: to foster connection, welcome curious travelers, and create spaces where people can live, work, and recharge at their own pace. Dolce Vita Coliving follows a diffused coliving model: private rooms, coworking spaces, and shared areas are spread across restored medieval homes, all within a 3-minute walk. Instead of a single building, the village itself becomes your living space—authentic, human, and deeply connected to local life. Here, you live like a local with modern comforts: fast fiber internet (up to 10 Gbps), well-designed workspaces, and welcoming shared areas. We are an inclusive, sustainable, and pet-friendly community, where connections grow naturally through shared meals, outdoor experiences, and everyday village moments. Dolce Vita Coliving is not just a place to stay—it’s a slower, more intentional way to live and work in Italy.

records.title: Grand Central
records.scea90e502: We operate 2 sites in Valletta. On Archbishop Street we have a beautiful traditional building totalling 350m2 with private serviced offices for from 1 to around 15 people. The other is on Strait Street and is a Manhattan style loft of 400m2 with both coworking and drop-in desks, and serviced private offices for from 1 to 40 desks. Everyone has the same great managed services and use of the communal spaces at both sites; including the boardroom, meeting rooms, lounges, and roof terraces
records.description_markdown:
We opened our doors in August 2017 in the heart of the beautiful city of Valletta we call home

Since then we have had the pleasure of welcoming people from different countries, backgrounds and industries. We are pleased to say our lives have been enriched through the community we have built, and hope after some time with us you can say the same.

Both of our sites are a stone’s throw from Saint George’s Square at the very centre of Valletta. One is on the quiet mainly residential Archbishop Street and is a typical Maltese townhouse, full of character and featuring a central courtyard providing plenty of natural light and a rooftop terrace with stunning views across the Grand Harbour towards the 3 Cities. The other site is on top of the Marks and Spencer Building on buzzing Strait Street. It’s an open plan double height 220m2 super modern space with plenty of bare timber and exposed metal framework. Its terrace overlooks Marsamxett Harbour with views towards Sliema

The day to day running of the office is generally in the hands of Iain and Sarah. Ollie and Millie the dogs also chip in by giving everyone a warm and enthusiastic welcome. They’d love to meet your dogs so bring them in!

records.title: Workspace 6
records.scea90e502: Nestled under the tracks of Amsterdam Centraal, our cute co-working space is home to dozens of bicycles, a band room and an eclectic bunch of freelancers from all around the world. We frequently host jazz evenings, get-togethers and our annual parties always have tattooers on-site! We have a core community of long-time regulars, occasional bookers & always a new face or two. We look forward to meeting you!
records.description_markdown:
Workspace 6 was founded in 2010 and has been a hub for the creative scene in Amsterdam ever since. Visitors are alway initialy greeted by a mural by local graffiti legends, The London Police and walls, ceilings and aisles of bikes. Our community spans the gamut from graphic & industrial design to cacoa & kombucha entrepreneurs and, of course, web developers, marketeers, Blockchain, bike PR and even the occasional local cafe owner who we source our coffee beans from. 

We have a jazz series with local label Dox Records, screen films, host rides, and serves as a messenger alleycat checkpoint several times a year. We’re mobbed by BMX’ers every summer for the Bounty Hunters Jam and always have our ramps ready to roll out for impromptu sessions on the bike or skateboard.One of our confernce rooms is also a music studio with guitar, bass & PA + drums, piano and even a flat screen with an Nintendo 64 and old Xbox! We love to lunch together either in our dining room, on our patio or around the corner on the water. We’re frequently visited by friends, friends of friends and new firends that are freelancers looking for the coziest, most welcoming spot to hang, work, ride & shred situated under the tracks of Central Station! Come visit Workspace 6!

records.title: The Bee Hostel
records.scea90e502: The Bee hostel is a chic, modern and super-convenient take on the old-school youth hostel.
records.description_markdown:
Discover the charm of Amsterdam at The Bee Hostel, your home away from home since our grand opening in July 2022. Nestled near the enchanting Artis Zoo in the city center, our hostel offers a unique and welcoming experience for travelers seeking both comfort and style.

What sets The Bee Hostel apart is our commitment to providing a comfortable stay with hospitality and a personalized experience. Step into our exclusive Ladies-Only dorm or our Unisex Dormitories with uniquely designed beds with the look of the bee hives, all beds come equipped with a privacy curtain and an electrical panel with a reading light and charger. We are offering privacy and practical space in the heart of the vibrant city.

Experience luxury on a budget at The Bee Hostel, where our facilities seamlessly blend comfort, style, and cleanliness. Our beds are not just a place to rest; they are a statement, reflecting our dedication to providing a memorable stay. Whether you're a solo traveler, a group of friends, or a globetrotting adventurer, The Bee Hostel has a space for all, ensuring a stay that is both affordable and unique.

Indulge in the pleasure of a cozy, and thoughtfully designed facility that makes The Bee Hostel the perfect base for your Amsterdam exploration. Discover a new standard of hospitality at The Bee Hostel, where every stay is an invitation to enjoy the best of Amsterdam in comfort and style.

It's an experience—a place where luxury meets budget without compromising on quality.

records.title: Cowork Funchal
records.scea90e502: Cowork Funchal
records.description_markdown:
We have always been passionate about buildings with history. With character.

Twelve years ago, Cowork Funchal was a risky dream of a young entrepreneur in Madeira, when people barely knew what a coworking space was. Today, we are proud of the family we have built, of the many friends who return often because they feel at home here.

We have 5 coworking rooms with 53 desks available; an outdoor patio that charms with its uncompromising charisma, and 24 possible workspaces.

Yes, we've also surrendered to the benefits of having phone booths at the house.

At our place, you'll find 2 meeting rooms and another 2 reserved for training. We are also fortunate to have 11 private offices. 

And we could go on, but we prefer to sum it up: at Cowork Funchal, we have plenty of space and are eager to welcome all those who, whether near or far, prefer to work in a suitable space, with the plus of a friendly community.
records.s5716bab58: The first coworking space that started it all, I was a proud member for 5 years & was a big part of my life in Madeira so definitely merits an inclusion along with other great coworking spaces in the world. By budgettraveller

records.title: Vertical Coworking Dom Henrique
records.scea90e502:
Coworking e Escritórios Privados no Porto: Flexibilidade e Conexão no Vertical Coworking
Oferecemos espaços de coworking, escritórios privados, escritórios virtuais, salas de reunião e espaços para eventos ideais para freelancers, startups e empresas. Trabalhe, conecte-se e cresça.
records.description_markdown: With a modern and sophisticated infrastructure, Vertical Dom Henrique is designed to offer a premium coworking experience, adapted to the needs of professionals, startups, and innovative companies. Located in one of the city's most emblematic buildings, Vertical Dom Henrique stands out for its contemporary design, large spaces, and impressive views over Porto. The space combines elegance and functionality, providing an inspiring environment for those seeking productivity and well-being in the workplace. The new space is Vertical Coworking's third unit in the city of Porto, along with Vertical Bolhão and Vertical Firmeza. As part of Feel Group, Vertical aims to provide unique experiences in its various operations, combining mobility, quality stays, and unforgettable activities. This coworking space has 40 seats in open space, 156 seats spread over 14 private offices, 5 meeting rooms with capacity for up to 20 people, and a room dedicated to podcasts and streaming. In total, Vertical Dom Henrique has 1600 square metres of pure Flexible Office, ready to provide tailored solutions for any team. Members have access to premium services, including personalized reception, high-speed internet, relaxation areas, and a workcafe with daily menus suited to the community's tastes. In addition, there is a wellness space that offers classes and events every week, promoting a balance between work and well-being. The 4th floor also has a rooftop which is freely accessible to the entire community when there are no events taking place. In addition, this floor is prepared for conferences of up to 100 people and events for more than 100 participants. The space was designed in collaboration with leading companies Feel Arch, responsible for the Architecture and Decoration Project, Alphalink, responsible for project management and supervision, and Sutega, in charge of carrying out the work and coordinating the various subcontracts. Vertical Coworking reinforces its commitment to flexibility by offering plans that can be adapted to different professional profiles, from freelancers to large companies. It also promotes a dynamic and vibrant community, with exclusive events, workshops, and networking opportunities that foster innovation and professional growth.

records.title: Madeira Friends Hub
records.scea90e502: The Madeira Friends Hub is a cool community space in the heart of Funchal’s Old Town. It’s a hybrid between a coworking space and a community center, a place to meet people, share skills, exchange knowledge, and join professional or social activities.
records.description_markdown:
It all started with burpees.

What began as sweaty workouts in Funchal’s old town grew into Madeira’s most welcoming community with events and activities for every personality.

But we wanted more than workouts. We dreamed of a place to connect, share skills, host workshops and events, work from, and build ideas together. After months of searching, we found it: the Madeira Friends Hub.

Just steps from where it all began, it offers both indoor and outdoor space, a bold black-and-white character, views towards the cable car and the best part? It even welcomes our paw friends. Best of all, the renovation was brought to life with help from our community.

What makes it special? It’s not just a hub, it’s the Madeira Friends community

Madeira Friends Hub: building Madeira’s future, a home for locals and internationals.

records.title: Albufeira Coworking
records.scea90e502: We are a coworking and community of expats, locals, and remote professionals working, connecting, and growing together in the heart of Albufeira, Portugal.
records.description_markdown:
It’s really been a ride opening Albufeira coworking!

I, Rebecca, was so fed up by working from the kitchen, longing for connection and community - and together with my partner Ivo, we decided to do something about it. The idea was not only to have a shared space, but create a meeting point and community for people in similar situation. A place to share and exchange ideas, connect and help each other to grow (and have fun of course) . We couldn't be the only ones in Albufeira being in this situation?

After a lot of research and long hunt for the perfect venue (that's a whole another story!) we finally got the keys to Rua do Ténis 13, in the heart of Albufeira 🚪🔑. It’s a small place with 22 seats, but with a lot of heart. 

The doors opened at the end of November 2023. 

We are so lucky to have a group of amazing people sitting with us 🙌. It's freelancers, entrepreneurs, remote workers and employees, locals and expats, staying long-term and short-term. Programmers, designers, marketers, traders..

Whether you're looking for a place to work, network and grow or simply want to hang out over a beer or two - you are warm welcome to join the community.

records.title: Pisarna, coworking & flex offices
records.scea90e502:
Welcome to Pisarna, the largest coworking hub in Slovenia with a thriving network of over 100 members.

At the heart of everything we do is our community. It is our most important value because we believe great ideas don’t happen in isolation. Whether you’re a freelancer or an entrepreneur, you’ll find a supportive environment where collaboration comes naturally and you never have to work alone.
records.description_markdown:
Our journey began in 2023 with a simple vision: to create a space where no one has to work alone. We started as a small, tight-knit group of 25 members in a former factory Elma, a place once famous for manufacturing home apliances. We’ve kept that industrious spirit alive (quite literally!). If you walk through our halls today, you’ll find a collection of original Elma irons on display, a nod to the craftsmanship that happened in these very rooms decades ago.

Since those early days, we haven't stopped growing. By expanding our space year after year, we have evolved into a thriving ecosystem. In just two months, we will be celebrating our 3rd anniversary with nearly 110 members. While our square footage has changed, our "Community First" heart remains the same. We aren't just a place to plug in a laptop; we are a strong, connected family that proves we are always better together.

We have a self service Cafeteria where we provide water, tea, coffee and milk for free. A bright and spacious ground floor where there are plenty of comfortable workstations. In the Basement we have a meeting room and other shared desks. Skype room, projectors, printer and scanner are also provided. Chill in our comfortable living room and just feel at home at la Vaca. What really makes La Vaca Coworking special is our vibrant and strong community, genuine connections and friendships among our coworkers.
